meta_title: Tolimoto — motorcycles, the garage and a service log
meta_desc: Tolimoto is a motorcycle channel: rides, doing your own maintenance and honest numbers. Also home of Tolimoto Log, a service and fuel log for your bike and car.
hero_lead: A motorcycle channel without the gloss: rides, doing your own maintenance, and honest numbers on what owning a bike really costs.
ch_lead: I film what I actually do: where I ride, what I fix in the garage and what it costs. No staging, no one-day reviews.
p1_text: Routes, weather, fatigue — everything the ads leave out.
p2_text: Oil, chain, brakes, consumables: step by step, with torque specs and part numbers.
p3_text: Every fill-up and every receipt is logged. That's where the sheet and the app came from.
app_lead: A service and fuel log for your motorcycle and car. It remembers when the oil is due, works out consumption and spending — and keeps everything with you.
f1_d: The main button on the first screen; swipe to pick the vehicle.
f2_d: What is due and when, with a clear status.
f3_d: Per fill-up, per year, and the cost of a kilometre.
f4_d: Your records live on your phone.
f5_d: Two-way sync; receipt photos on your own Drive.
f6_d: Bring your fill-up history over in a minute.
trust: Tolimoto runs no servers holding your data. Records stay on your device and, if you connect Google, in your own spreadsheet and Drive folder. The app can only see files it created itself.
app_langs_note: The app itself speaks English and Russian for now; more languages are on the way.
alt_home: Home screen: odometer, fill-up button and upcoming jobs
alt_sched: Schedule screen: what is due and when
inst_lead: Tolimoto Log is a web app: there is nothing to download from a store. Add it to your home screen and it opens full-screen like any other app and works offline.
ios1_d: Go to app.tolimoto.com in Safari, the browser that comes with the iPhone.
ios2_d: The square with an arrow pointing up, in the bar at the bottom of the screen.
ios3_d: Scroll down the list if you don't see it straight away.
ios4_d: You can keep the name Tolimoto Log or shorten it.
ios5_t: Open it from the Home Screen
ios5_d: From now on, start the app from its icon, not from Safari.
and2_d: The three dots in the top-right corner.
and3_d: On some phones it is called “Add to Home screen”.
and4_d: Tap “Install”. Chrome may also offer this by itself at the bottom of the screen.
and5_t: Open it from the home screen
and5_d: The icon appears on the home screen and in the app list.
inst_warn: On iPhone, the installed app keeps its own storage, separate from Safari. Add it to the Home Screen before you enter your data — or move your records over with a JSON backup from Settings.
inst_android_note: On Android the app works in Chrome; it was built and tested on iPhone first, so tell us if something looks off.
illust_note: The pictures are simplified; menu names can differ slightly between system versions.
sheet_lead: A free Google Sheets template: maintenance schedule, service history and yearly spending. Make a copy and log your own bike.
sheet_langs_note: Other languages — opens Google Sheets with a “Make a copy” button; the copy lands in your own Drive.
contact_lead: Questions about the app or the sheet, ideas for videos, collaborations — write to us.
pv_desc: How Tolimoto Log and tolimoto.com handle your data.
pv_translation: This is a translation for convenience; if anything differs, the English version applies.
